FFmpeg 9.0.2 essentials build from https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
This app invokes FFmpeg as a separate process for Desktop Duplication capture,
H.264 NVIDIA NVENC video encoding and AAC audio encoding. The distributed build
is licensed under GNU GPL version 3; see FFmpeg.LICENSE.txt.

Unmodified binary package used:
https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/packages/ffmpeg-9.0.2-essentials_build.zip
Corresponding source provided by the build distributor:
https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/packages/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz
Upstream: https://ffmpeg.org/
